spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact FontFace.width contract in both directions — construct-with-one-read-the-other plus post-construction assignment — with a stretch-only control row, which is precisely the alias semantics the feature ships.

interactive.rationale: A value select (percentages and keywords) and a run button re-execute the four probes plus control against freshly constructed FontFace objects; auto-runs on load too.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises a bidirectional alias probe on a real FontFace and the page does exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Construction errors are caught per probe, the expando-property failure mode is explicitly narrated, and the control distinguishes a broken environment from a missing alias.

conformance.rationale: The suite's fontface-width-aliases-stretch and assignment-propagates assertions mirror these probes; on Chromium 141 /conformance/ honestly reported 2 pass / 5 fail with all font-width assertions failing pre-154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): ran the probes — 0/4 aliased with the control passing (stretch reads back 75%), verdict banner rose, detail correctly warned that .width writes become silent expandos on this build; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs per-run alias results (aliasProbes/control) to the console and telemetry.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, verdict states as text plus colour, focusable code block, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select, captioned table with scoped headers, aria-live detail, verdict text beside aria-hidden icon.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360x740 DPR3 the document measures 366px and the mobile screenshot shows the verdict banner, Run button and the table's 'aliased?' column clipped a few pixels at the right edge.

openQuestions.title: Remove the 6px 360px overflow on the probes table and controls row
openQuestions.detail: At a 360px viewport the page measures 366px: the four-column probe table (mono headers, no overflow-wrap:anywhere on this page's th/td) and the controls row push slightly past the edge, clipping the 'aliased?' column and the Run button border. Add overflow-wrap:anywhere to the table cells and allow the select/button row to shrink (min-width:0), then re-verify with deno task responsive-check.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/fontface-width-attribute-and-font-width-descriptor/alias-probe/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), which predates FontFace.width. The probes behaved exactly as a pre-154 build should — 0/4 aliased, control passing, and a first-class explanation of the silent-expando failure mode, which is the page's best teaching moment. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; /conformance/ honestly reported 2 pass / 5 fail. One minor responsive defect: a 6px overflow at 360px clipping the table's last column.
